mods.name: Xray
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: See ores and gems through the ground.
mods.description:
Press your Xray key and stone, dirt and sand fade away, leaving only the stuff worth digging for. Ores, gems, crystals and rare blocks stay visible, so you can see where a vein is before you dig.

You choose what shows. There's a switch for every ore and gem (iron, coal, gold, cobalt, sulphur, amethyst, pyrite, devil ores and the rest), and for liquids like water, lava, acid and swamp. There are separate groups for space rocks and value blocks too. All On and All Off flip a whole group at once.

Don't like everything around you going invisible? Turn up the Ground see-through slider and the ground stays faintly visible, so you can still tell where the edges are and don't walk off a cliff.
mods.changelog:
- Ores in hell now show their real look instead of another block's texture
- Less stutter with lots of lava around: finding and drawing the highlight now runs on your other CPU cores
Needs framework 1.0.5

mods.name: Block Story Core
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: The framework every Mod Kit mod runs on — install it once, it updates itself.
mods.description:
Block Story Core is the engine room behind every mod in the Mod Kit. It loads your mods when the game starts and gives them a shared toolbox, so creators don't rebuild the basics every time: adding blocks and items, making custom creatures and pets with their own models, hooking into the world, the player and game events, and binding keys. It also adds the "Mods" button to the game's main menu so you can see and manage what's running.

If a mod says it "needs Core," this is it. You install it once — after that it updates on its own through the Mod Kit whenever there's a new version. On its own it changes nothing about how the game plays; it just makes the other mods work.

─────────────────────────────
For creators: everything in Core is optional

Use the parts you want and skip the rest. Settings pages, keybinds, icons, control tips, items, creatures and pets are all there if you need them, and none of it shows up if you don't. The full list is in the Toolbox SDK guide in the Mod Kit.

For creators: adding your mod to the Mods menu

If you build with the Mod Kit, this is already done for you — your mod shows up in the in-game Mods button, with its own on/off switch, automatically.

If you're coding a mod without the Kit, it takes one step. Reference BlockStoryCore.dll (it sits in your game's BepInEx/plugins folder once Core is installed), and in your plugin's Awake() register with the toolbox:

    using BlockStoryCore;

    ModRegistry.Register(new ModInfo
    {
        Name        = "My Mod",
        Description = "What my mod does.",
        GetEnabled  = () => _enabled,        // your mod's current on/off state
        SetEnabled  = on => _enabled = on,   // flip your mod on/off
        HasConfig   = true,                  // false if your mod has no settings
        OpenConfig  = () => { /* open your settings screen */ }
    });

That's the whole hook. Core draws the row, the ON/OFF switch, and (if HasConfig) a Config button, and the menu scrolls to fit any number of mods. The rest of the toolbox — blocks, items, creatures, pets, world/player/event hooks, keybinds — lives in the same BlockStoryCore namespace; see the toolbox docs for those.
mods.changelog: - Small fixes behind the scenes

mods.name: Character Editor
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Change your stats, items, world and quests.
mods.description:
A full editor for your character and your world, for single-player.

- Stats: set your level, XP, skill points and diamonds. Fill or raise your health, mana, breath and hunger, set your armour and damage, or turn on god mode.
- World: switch between Survival, Creative, Story, Hardcore and Sandbox without losing your stuff. You can also turn on flying in any mode, set the time of day and pick the weather.
- Inventory: add any item to your bag, crafting slots or hotbar. Fill your equipment slots and repair your gear.
- Pets: edit your summoned pet's level, XP, health and hunger.
- Quests: start, finish or reset any quest, with or without the reward.
- Achievements: complete them one at a time or all at once.
- Saves: save your whole loadout and load it back later.

Good for testing a build, fixing a save that went wrong, or just playing your way.
mods.changelog:
- Tab no longer jumps into the search box, for players who use Tab as their inventory key
Needs framework 1.0.5

mods.name: Minimap
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: A minimap, a full world map and waypoints.
mods.description:
A round minimap in the corner of your screen shows the land around you, with mobs, animals and NPCs marked with their names. It can stay pointing north or turn with you. You can zoom it, make it bigger or show your coordinates above it. N, E, S and W sit on the ring and on the world map, and can be switched off.

Open the full world map for the big picture. It remembers everywhere you've been, so the map fills in as you explore. Drag it around, zoom in and out, or switch between the surface and cave view.

Waypoints let you mark your base, a good mine or anywhere else you want to find again. Pick a name, colour and icon, and it shows on both maps with how far away it is. Right-click the world map to drop one right there. When you die, a waypoint goes where it happened, so you can go get your stuff back.

Every world keeps its own map and waypoints. Realms and online servers get their own too, so they never draw over each other.
mods.changelog:
- No more lag spikes with the minimap or world map zoomed out. The map is drawn a bit at a time instead of all at once
Needs framework 1.0.11

mods.name: NPC Menu
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Talk to any NPC from anywhere.
mods.description:
Press the NPC key for a list of every NPC in the game. Click Talk and their normal quest window opens, as if you'd walked up to them. Take new quests or hand in finished ones without the long walk back.

The number next to each name shows how many quests that NPC has for you, so you can see who's worth visiting.

NPCs are switched off in Creative mode, so the menu only works in the other modes.
mods.changelog:
- Fixed: the mouse locked again after every click in a quest window opened from the menu
- A shop NPC that's far away now says to go near them instead of doing nothing
Needs framework 1.0.11

mods.name: Xenor
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: A new creature you can fight, catch and ride.
mods.description:
Xenor is a big new alien creature that lives in the space biomes. It levels up as you go further out, hits hard, spits acid, and drops meat, acid, bone, graviton and sometimes dark matter.

You can get your own Xenor in two ways:
- Catch it: catch a wild one with a soul catcher to get its spawner. Then craft the Xenor Soul from the spawner, Spider Fangs, a Dragon Heart, Dragonscale and Bones.
- Buy it: buy the Xenor Soul with diamonds.

Hold the soul and your Xenor appears as a pet. It follows you, fights for you, levels up and has its own inventory. You can name it, and you can climb on and ride it.
mods.changelog:
- Fixes the Update button that wouldn't go away
Needs framework 1.4.0

mods.name: Vein Miner
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Break a whole ore vein in one hit.
mods.description:
Hit one block of ore and every connected block of the same kind breaks with it. Everything goes straight into your inventory, and you still get your XP and your normal drop chances for each block.

It isn't only for ore. Switch the dig shape to dig a pillar up or down, or cut a staircase up or down. Choose how many blocks a single hit can take and how deep the shapes go.

Your tool wears per block like normal mining, or you can turn that off. Protect my tool stops it just before your pick breaks, so you never lose a good one halfway through a vein.

Press the Vein Miner key to turn it on or off whenever you like.
mods.changelog:
- Tidier log file, no change in game
Needs framework 1.0.5

mods.name: Soul Tools
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Spawners spawn on every click and the soul catcher locks on from any distance.
mods.description:
Two fixes for things that feel random in the base game.

Sure-fire spawners: left click a spawner and it spawns one creature, every single click. Mob caps, a crowd around it or a shaky mouse no longer eat your clicks. The spawner's own timer keeps running like normal, this only adds the ones you ask for.

Lock-on soul catcher: aim at a creature and click once. The catch locks on and keeps charging by itself, at any range, even if you let go or walk off. Click again or put the staff away to stop. Mana works like normal.

Both parts have their own switch in the settings. Single player only.
mods.changelog:
- Fixed: a creature from a spawner could appear inside the spawner or a wall
- New Soul catcher durability slider
Needs framework 1.0.11

mods.name: Better Fishing
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Auto catch, every catch lands, no rod cooldown and a tougher rod.
mods.description:
Fishing without the waiting and the misses.

Auto catch reels in the moment a fish bites, before it can break the line. Every catch lands, the base game only lands about half. No rod cooldown, so you can throw again straight away. Rod wear is a slider: 100% is normal, 25% makes the rod last about 4 times longer, 0% means it never wears out.

Bait still gets used like normal. Every option has its own switch.
mods.changelog: - First release

mods.name: Better Aim
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Lock on to a target and bend your shots to it.
mods.description:
Aim help for bows, guns, the rocket launcher and magic. Set a lock key and a next target key in the settings. Press the lock key and it grabs what you aim near, or the closest creature in front of you, and red corners mark your target. After a kill it moves on to the closest one by itself. A path line shows where your arrow will go, and your shots can curve in to the locked target. Looking through a scope, it only picks what's inside the scope.

Every weapon type has its own switch. You can also set how strong the aim is, how fast shots curve, whether the arrow path shows, and whether animals and NPCs count as targets. It locks in front of you, or switch on Lock on all around you for 360.

Works on multiplayer servers too.
mods.changelog:
- The lock tip goes away as soon as you let go of the target
Needs framework 1.0.8

mods.name: Better Bows
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Faster bows, arrows that pierce, and upgrades up to +5.
mods.description:
Hold to draw and let go to shoot, with no cooldown. The bow stays drawn for as long as you hold. Arrows pass through enemies, you zoom in while drawing, and a full draw can land a critical hit. You can get your arrows back too.

Upgrade your bow at the crafting table, from +1 up to +5. Each level adds damage, arrow speed, a faster draw and one more enemy pierced. From +3 it fires 3 arrows. At +5 that is 125% more damage, 75% more arrow speed and a 60% faster draw.

Draw time, piercing, zoom, critical hits, multi-shot and arrows recovered are all in the settings.

Works on multiplayer servers too.
mods.changelog:
- Upgraded bows really hit harder now. The extra damage used to leave out your bow skill, so it was tiny, and a sleeping creature ignored it completely
Needs framework 1.0.11

mods.name: Better Guns
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: A bolt action rifle, four new bullets and sliders for your guns.
mods.description:
Adds a bolt action rifle that hits as far as you can see and harder than the hand gun, with shots that go through 3 more enemies. Hold right click to look through the scope, and use the mouse wheel for 3 zoom levels.

Four new bullets fit every gun that shoots Bullets:
- Incendiary sets what it hits on fire for 4 seconds, harder guns burn harder
- Hollow-Point does 50% more damage
- Explosive makes a small blast on top of the bullet's damage, hurts nearby creatures and doesn't break blocks
- Armour-Piercing goes through 2 more enemies

Put a bullet in the ammo slot from the Equipment HUD mod to pick which one you shoot.

Sliders set damage, fire rate, range, spread and recoil. Each one starts at 1, the game's own value. Rockets no longer damage the world.

Works on multiplayer servers too.
mods.changelog:
- The bolt action rifle hits 5 times as hard as the hand gun, gun skill included
- It lasts 10 times longer
- Much dearer to craft: 10 Iron Block, 6 Unobtainium Bar, 2 Electrite, 20 GunPowder, 16 Plank, 4 Glass
Needs framework 1.0.11

mods.name: Better Magic
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Sliders for your staffs and tridents.
mods.description:
Tune your staffs and tridents with six sliders: range, attack speed, durability, damage, mana cost and mana refill. Every slider starts at 1, the game's own value, so nothing changes until you move it. Magic swords stay as they are.

In creative worlds a button in the settings gives you every staff.

Works on multiplayer servers too.
mods.changelog:
- Now works on multiplayer servers
Needs framework 1.4.2

mods.name: Build Wand
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Build in big pieces, then undo if you don't like it.
mods.description:
Hold the wand to build in big pieces: extend a surface, draw lines, walls, floors and boxes, make spheres, fill holes, and swap blocks between two points. A yellow outline shows what will be built before you commit.

Right click builds, left click cancels and the middle button picks the block you're looking at. There are keys for the next mode and for undo, and you can change both. You can also set the most blocks placed at once and how far Fill Hole reaches.

Craft the wand from a Gold Bar and two Sticks. In creative worlds a button in the settings gives you one.

Works on multiplayer servers too.
mods.changelog:
- Now works on multiplayer servers
- Other players see the wand in your hand
Needs framework 1.4.2

mods.name: Equipment HUD
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: See your gear's durability and get real slots for ammo, torch, potions and food.
mods.description:
Shows your worn gear and its durability above the hotbar. It also adds real slots for ammo, a torch that lights without you holding it, health potions, mana potions and food.

Drop any ammo on the ammo slot and it all stays inside, with a +1 or +2 on the slot showing how many other types are in there. Lift one out and the next comes up. Point at the slot with a window open to see what's inside: left click brings one to the front, right click sends it to your bag. The next ammo key only cycles what fits your weapon, and the slot swaps by itself when you change weapon.

There are keys for the torch and for changing ammo, and optional keys for using a potion or eating. Auto health potion, auto mana potion and auto food can each be switched on or off.

Everything works on multiplayer servers too.
mods.changelog:
- Quick use and auto use now work on multiplayer servers
Needs framework 1.4.2

mods.name: Gravestone
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Die and your items wait in a grave instead of dropping.
mods.description:
When you die your items go into a grave at that spot instead of dropping on the ground. Right click it to get them back. If your bag is full the rest stays in the grave until you make room. Worn gear stays on you, same as the normal game.

The distance to your grave shows on screen so you can find your way back, and graves can be marked on the map. Both can be switched off.

Works on multiplayer servers too. In realms you drop your items the normal way.
mods.changelog:
- Now works on multiplayer servers. The grave's list is kept on the PC of the player who died
Needs framework 1.4.2

mods.name: Pet Recall
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: One key summons all your pets, or sends them all back.
mods.description:
Press one key to summon every pet in your bag, and press it again to send them all back. Dead pets are skipped so you don't spend diamonds.

You can change the key and set the most pets you can have out at once.

Works on multiplayer servers too.
mods.changelog:
- Now works on multiplayer servers
Needs framework 1.4.2

mods.name: Flicker Fix
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Fixes certain blocks flickering against each other.
mods.description:
Fixes certain blocks flickering against each other, especially blocks seen from a distance.

This only helps if you see this flicker. If you don't, you don't need it.

Tested on Linux. It should work on Windows too, but that isn't confirmed.

There is one strength slider. Raise it if flicker remains. Too high and you start seeing through blocks up close.
mods.changelog:
First release.

mods.name: More Inventory Slots
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: All your bag slots open from the start, plus extra rows.
mods.description:
Still works, but no longer updated. Everything from More Slots is now built into Better Inventory by BlueKitsunex777x, so grab that instead for the improved version.

All your bag slots are open from the start, and you can add extra rows on top.

The number of rows can only be changed from the main menu.

Works on multiplayer servers too.
mods.changelog:
- Now works on multiplayer servers
Needs framework 1.4.2

mods.name: Mouse Controls
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Minecraft style inventory controls, sorting, Take all and Store all, and hold right click to keep placing blocks.
mods.description:
Every inventory and chest works with the mouse the way you'd expect from Minecraft.

Picking up and putting down
Left click picks up a stack and left click puts it down. Right click takes half, then places one at a time. Let go outside a window and nothing lands on the ground, it stays in your hand. Left click outside a window and it goes back where it came from. Right click outside a window throws one on the ground, with shift the whole stack. Armor, rings and other gear pick up and drag like anything else, they don't put themselves on when you click them.

Item info
Pick up an item and left click the i button to read about it. It goes back where it came from.

Sharing a stack out
Hold a stack, press and drag over slots. Left drag shares it evenly and whatever's left stays in your hand. Right drag places one in each slot, go over them again to add one more.

Gathering
Double click an item, or shift click one while you're holding it, and every stack of it in the open windows comes to your hand. Tools stack too, but two worn stacks won't go together, that's the game's rule.

Sending across
Shift click sends a stack from bag to chest and back, or bag to hotbar when no chest is open. Stacks fill in order from the first slot. With no chest open, shift clicking gear puts it on if that spot is free. Keep holding and drag to send every slot you pass over. Shift double click sends every stack of that item.

Shift and mouse wheel
Hold shift over a stack, wheel down sends one across and wheel up brings one back. The plain wheel still scrolls the bag, even with an item on the mouse.

Number keys
With a window open, point at an item and press 1 to 0. It goes to that hotbar slot and whatever was there swaps back.

Sorting
Every bag and chest has a small Sort button on top. The button next to it picks how: Type groups blocks, tools, food and so on, A-Z goes by name, and Amount puts the biggest stacks first. Stacks of the same thing join up as they sort. You can set a key to sort whatever you're pointing at, and a key to switch the sort type.

Chests
Take all empties the chest into your bag. Store all empties your bag into the chest, your hotbar stays as it is. Top up only sends things the chest already has.

Locked slots
Point at a bag or hotbar slot and press your lock key. A gold frame shows it's locked, and sorting, Store all and Top up leave it alone. Press again to unlock.

Drop key
Set your own key in the settings. It drops one of what you're pointing at with a window open, or what's in your hand when there's no window. Hold ctrl to drop the whole stack. Things the game asks about before dropping are left alone.

Out in the world
Hold right click to keep placing blocks instead of clicking for each one, and set how many blocks per second. Summons and vehicles still take a single click, and this part is off on servers.

Each of these can be switched off on its own.
mods.changelog:
- New: Sort button on every bag and chest, sort by type, A-Z or amount, with keys for both
- New: Take all, Store all and Top up buttons on chests
- New: lock bag and hotbar slots so sorting and storing leave them alone
- Fixed: the bag wouldn't scroll while an item was on the mouse
Needs framework 1.0.11

mods.name: Auto Pickup
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: What you mine or kill goes straight into your bag.
mods.description:
What you mine or kill goes straight into your bag, and your pets' kills too. If the bag is full, items drop like normal.

Blocks you mine, creatures you kill, creatures your pets kill, and coins and gems each have their own switch.

On a server you only ever get your own loot. Not fully tested on servers yet.
mods.changelog:
First release.
Needs framework 1.4.0

mods.name: OG Replicator
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: The Replicator copies any block again.
mods.description:
The Replicator copies any block again, like it did before the limits came in. That brings back ores, crystals, metal blocks, spawners, the Teleporter, the Safebox and the rest of the blocks the game stopped it copying.

A slider sets how long the Replicator lasts. It starts at 1, the game's own value.

Works on multiplayer servers too.
mods.changelog:
- Now works on multiplayer servers
Needs framework 1.4.2

mods.name: Fewer Structures
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Fewer villages and buildings in land you haven't explored.
mods.description:
Fewer villages and buildings in land you haven't explored yet. Trees and plants are left alone, and places you've already been stay as they are.

A slider sets the percent of buildings that still appear. It can only be changed from the main menu.

Works on multiplayer servers too, as long as everyone on the server uses the same setting.
mods.changelog:
- Server settings now apply after you join, before they were ignored until you left the world
Needs framework 1.4.2

mods.name: Climb Stairs Faster
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: You move faster on stairs.
mods.description:
You move faster while you're on stairs. Going up and going down each have their own speed slider.

Works on multiplayer servers too.
mods.changelog:
- Now works on multiplayer servers
Needs framework 1.4.2

mods.name: Server Invites
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: A mod for servers. Still in development.
mods.description: A mod for playing on servers. Still in development, so things will change and there may be bugs.
mods.changelog:
- Tidier log file, no change in game
Needs framework 1.0.6

mods.name: Instant Furnaces
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Furnaces and cauldrons finish instantly, same fuel cost.
mods.description:
No more waiting on furnaces. Put in your ore and fuel and the whole stack is smelted straight away.

Fuel costs the same as always, one piece per smelt. Cauldrons are instant too.

Works online as well. A full stack finishes in one go instead of hundreds of little steps, which also makes furnaces a lot more reliable on servers.
mods.changelog:
First release.
Needs framework 1.4.2

mods.name: Craft From Inventory
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: A recipe panel by the crafting grid that pulls from your bag and nearby chests.
mods.description:
Crafting without the back-and-forth. Craft From Inventory puts a recipe panel right next to your crafting grid, in your inventory and at the crafting table. Find what you want by category or search, click it, and the ingredients drop straight into the grid. It pulls from your bag and from any chests nearby, so you don't have to go fetch stuff first.

Want a lot? Ctrl-click loads 10 crafts, Shift-click loads 100, and Alt-click adds one more each time with a running count. The same keys work on the crafted item to make that many in one go. Changed your mind? Clear sends everything back to the chest it came from.

Short on parts? If you have the materials for them it offers to make them first, as many as the materials stretch to. Furnace recipes still need a furnace, so those aren't offered.

Quick stack is in too. Press one key and everything in your bag goes onto matching stacks in nearby chests, without opening them. Your hotbar and tools stay put.

Only shows recipes you've unlocked, so it won't spoil your progress. You can peek at locked ones if you want. Chest range is a slider from 4 to 64 blocks. Single player only.
mods.changelog:
- Works with Bigger Safebox on Block Story Servers: pulls from and stacks into all 36 slots, not just the top 16
Needs framework 1.0.6

mods.name: Better Inventory
mods.author: BlueKitsunex777x
mods.summary: Increases inventory size
mods.description:
You can increase both the rows and the columns, extra rows unlock like normal, every 10 levels after level 120
There is a toggle to unlock all rows in your inventory from the start

Columns - min: 5      | max: 10
Rows       - min: 12    | max: 50

More Slots by MR C is now merged into Better Inventory, all its features are included and improved here

Safeboxes get 6x6 slots
Changes from the main menu only
Before turning it off, take items out of the bottom slots: a safebox with something past slot 16 won't open without this mod

A Big Chest with 64 slots. Put two side by side and they become one chest with 128.

mods.name: Sneak
mods.author: BSMK
mods.summary: Hold Shift to sneak, and never walk off an edge.
mods.description:
Hold Shift to sneak. You walk slowly and you can't fall off the edge of a block, so building on cliffs, towers and bridges is safe.

Pick any key you like, or switch the key between hold and toggle. Sneak speed, stopping at edges and the lowered view each have their own setting.
